history: R2 metrics and service budget formulated after R1 outcomes were known
normal_cost: best robust natural RMSE + max(2%,0.05m), all controls included in unqualified tables
extended_rule: evaluate every method on same full expected grid; retain missing/partial status; no successful intersection
t_return: first actually present sensor observation after deletion end
t_admit: first accepted KF update after t_return; right censor at fixed 180s observation window
bias_risk: injected-row acceptance is a stress risk proxy, never field wrong-GNSS probability
latency_clock: primary: measurement_sow of accepted update; separately report available_sow conservative bound; neither is measured wall-clock arrival
deadline_boundary_rule: inclusive on measurement-clock latency, 1e-8s tolerance; availability-bound eligibility reported separately
event_aggregation: equal-weight per-event RMSE macro; no successful-only removal
clock_alias: P_time_only at good_duration_s=2 is exactly Clock2
hypothesis_gate: H2 requires risk reduction and error reduction versus every fast normal-cost-qualified baseline; H3 requires independent new route and attribution
reference_role: time/schema only plus one earliest common-covered reference state before freeze, remaining states only offline after exact remote verification
unsupported_event_rule: block complete primary matrix; do not advance/reselect by method error
coverage_gate: complete expected whole route and all five windows; no successful intersection
scientific_effect_requirement: same original15s/natural/coverage joint gates per route, plus descriptive P vs Clock2 and no-anchor; report all route/event signs and stronger baselines; no universal or novelty inference
event_support: fixed offsets from common sensor-reference initialization, audit lower bound from first usable GNSS/IMU and validate again at actual cache-covered init before freeze
measurement_maximum: whole horizontal max and every full window max are descriptive extras; primary unchanged
time_basis: independently audited bag custom GPS week and raw-text SOW; no assumed week
external_performance_scope: official public dataset literature may contain route tables; no local method performance or tuning before full freeze
figure_selection: all routes in fixed list order; first fixed event by order for any event trace, never chosen by accuracy
optional_rule: include building02 if five immutable originals pass official/hash/time/support audit and reused frontend/cache before collective freeze; no result-based inclusion
route_aggregation: equal-weight per-route event-macro RMSE, with all per-route values/negative evidence reported; never remove unfavorable routes
frontend_execution: one predetermined1x frontend per route, maximum2 isolated frontend processes; no cache selection by accuracy
reference_initialization: single earliest original reference row at/after max(reference first timestamp, first IMU, first valid causal GNSS, first primary LIO cache timestamp); selection uses timestamps/input validity only, never position error
reference_duplicate_policy: nondecreasing times allowed, stable first original row per timestamp, no smoothing or alignment
Clock2_comparison: same fixed good-duration2 qualification as P; show actual per-event clean and biased admission clocks, never assume equal observed delays
excluded_route_rule: if technical support fails before collective freeze, retain route and failure in report; no performance exclusion
paper_primary_table_selection: P, Clock2, no-anchor, NIS30, Huber2.5, Clock90 plus strongest qualified non-P if absent; full19 biased values/all complete raw records remain visible
whole_route_expected_grid: 10Hz integer ticks over [earliest common reference initialization, min(reference end, ADIS text end, single primary LIO cache timestamp end)]; endpoint support decided from timestamps before precision, no internal/successful intersection or per-method crop
